  - Forging aluminium alloys consist mainly of EN AW-2XXX series
  - Sheet aluminium alloys consists minly of EN AW-5XXX series

# Get all the datasets needed and the fill them into the FutuRaM Dat template

## Loading of the libraries

We are using tidyverse framework to rearrange and analysis the data. 


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

library(readxl) # read excel files
library("openxlsx")   #The openxlsx package is highly customizable and allows you to: Write multiple data frames to different sheets of the same Excel file. Customize formatting, such as column widths, bold headers, and colors.

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tidyverse_conflicts()
```

# Get all the data, which are required

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

filename32_input <- "Data/32_VehicleComponentDataBase.xlsx"      # Different Keys, which are required to put together the composition data
filename33_input <- "Data/33_VehicleComponentAdditionalInformation.xlsx"   # Additional information to complete the composition data
filename34_input <- "Data/34_MaterialElementComponentComposition.xlsx"   # Additional information to complete the composition data
filename35_input <- "Data/35_VehicleComponentData.xlsx"

futuram_output <- "ComponentData/ELVComponent_1990_2050.xlsx"
futuram_output_short <- "ComponentData/ELVComponent_1990_2050_short.xlsx"


ProductKeyLevel1   <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "productKeyLevel1")
ProductKeyLevel2   <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "productKeyLevel2")

ComponentKeyLevel0 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "componentKeyLevel0")
ComponentKeyLevel1 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "componentKeyLevel1")
ComponentKeyLevel2 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "componentKeyLevel2")

MaterialKeyLevel0 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel0")
MaterialKeyLevel1 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel1")
MaterialKeyLevel2 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel2")
MaterialKeyLevel3 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel3")
MaterialKeyLevel4 <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel4")

Compositioncatalyst <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "catalyst")

AdditionalInformation <- read_excel(filename33_input, sheet = "additioanlInformation")

CompositionAlSiCu <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialAlSiCucomposition")
CompositionAlSiMg <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialAlSiMgcomposition")
CompositionAl_5xxx <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialAl_5xxxcomposition")
CompositionAl_6xxx <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialAl_6xxxcomposition")
CompositionAl_7xxx <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialAl_7xxxcomposition")

CompositioncastIron <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsFeCastIroncomposition")
CompositionmildSteel <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsFeMildSteelcomposition")
CompositionHSSteel <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsFeHSSteelcomposition")
CompositionUHSSteel <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsFeUHSSteelcomposition")

CompositioncableLike <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialscableInscomposition")
Compositioncontroller <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsContcomposition")
Compositionlight <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsLightscomposition")
CompositionpowerElectronic <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsPowerelcomposition")

CompositionpermanentMagnet <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialsPerMagnetcomposition")
CompositionengineCable <- read_excel(filename34_input, sheet = "materialscableEngcomposition")
```

# Define and prepare, which data from the new data should be added to the FutuRaM template

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

emptyValue <- "N/A"     # ""

vehicleNumber_Petrol <- 13 #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template
vehicleNumber_Diesel <- 13 #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template
vehicleNumber_BEV <- 13  #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template
vehicleNumber_HEV <- 13 #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template
vehicleNumber_PHEV <- 13 #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template
vehicleNumber_Others <- 13 #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template

# Product keys

productID <- 1 # needs to be provided from VehicleCompositionDataset_1.Rmd

productKeyLevel1 <- ProductKeyLevel1$productKeyLevel1     
productKeyLevel1Index <- 1 # 1 Petrol, 2 diesel, 3 BEV, 4 HEV, 5 PHEV, 6 Others

productKeyLevel2 <- ProductKeyLevel2$productKeyLevel2
productKeyLevel2Index <- 1  # 1-13 Petrol, 14 - 26 Diesel, 27 - 39 BEV, 40 - 52 HEV, 53 - 65 PHEV, 66 - 78 Others

segments <- unique(ProductKeyLevel2$segment)
segmentsLength <- length(segments)

durationYear <- c(1990, 2050)
predictionYear <- 2026 # Change szenario and also measure to perdiction
productionYear <- c(durationYear[1]:durationYear[2])
yearLength <- durationYear[2] - durationYear[1] + 1

componentID <- 1

componentIndex <- 1    # total number (21) of components handle with this code
materialIndex <- 1    # total number () of potential materials of a given component

componentKeyLevel0 <- ComponentKeyLevel0$componentKeyLevel0
componentKeyLevel0Index <- 1

componentKeyLevel1 <- ComponentKeyLevel1$componentKeyLevel1
componentKeyLevel1Length <- length(componentKeyLevel1)
componentKeyLevel1Index <- 1

componentKeyLevel2 <- ComponentKeyLevel2$componentKeyLevel2
componentKeyLevel2Length <- length(componentKeyLevel2)
componentKeyLevel2Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel0 <- MaterialKeyLevel0$materialKeyLevel0
materialKeyLevel0Length <- length(materialKeyLevel0)
materialKeyLevel0Index <- 2

materialKeyLevel1 <- MaterialKeyLevel1$materialKeyLevel1
materialKeyLevel1Length <- length(materialKeyLevel1)
materialKeyLevel1Index <- 2

materialKeyLevel2 <- MaterialKeyLevel2$materialKeyLevel2
materialKeyLevel2Length <- length(materialKeyLevel2)
materialKeyLevel2Index <- 8

materialKeyLevel3 <- MaterialKeyLevel3$materialKeyLevel3
materialKeyLevel3Length <- length(materialKeyLevel3)
materialKeyLevel3Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel4 <- MaterialKeyLevel4$materialKeyLevel4
materialKeyLevel4Length <- length(materialKeyLevel4)
materialKeyLevel4Index <- 0

cpIndex <- 0

materialElement_AlSiCu <- CompositionAlSiCu %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_AlSiCuLength <- nrow(materialElement_AlSiCu)

materialElement_AlSiMg <- CompositionAlSiMg %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_AlSiMgLength <- nrow(materialElement_AlSiMg)

materialElement_Al_5xxx <- CompositionAl_5xxx %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_Al_5xxxLength <- nrow(materialElement_Al_5xxx)

materialElement_Al_6xxx <- CompositionAl_6xxx %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_Al_6xxxLength <- nrow(materialElement_Al_6xxx)

materialElement_Al_7xxx <- CompositionAl_7xxx %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_Al_7xxxLength <- nrow(materialElement_Al_7xxx)

materialElement_castIron <- CompositioncastIron %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_castIronLength <- nrow(materialElement_castIron)

materialElement_mildSteel <- CompositionmildSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_mildSteelLength <- nrow(materialElement_mildSteel)

materialElement_HSS <- CompositionHSSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_HSSLength <- nrow(materialElement_HSS)

materialElement_AHSS <- CompositionAHSSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_AHSSLength <- nrow(materialElement_AHSS)

materialElement_UHSS <- CompositionUHSSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_UHSSLength <- nrow(materialElement_UHSS)

materialElement_magnesium <- CompositionMgAlloys %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_magnesiumLength <- nrow(materialElement_magnesium)

materialElement_catalyst <- Compositioncatalyst$Element
materialElement_catalystLength <- length(materialElement_catalyst)

materialElement_actuator <- Compositionactuator %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_actuatorLength <- nrow(materialElement_actuator)

materialElement_cableLike <- CompositioncableLike %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_cableLikeLength <- nrow(materialElement_cableLike)

materialElement_controller <- Compositioncontroller %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_controllerLength <- nrow(materialElement_controller)

materialElement_light <- Compositionlight %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_lightLength <- nrow(materialElement_light)

materialElement_powerElectronic <- CompositionpowerElectronic %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_powerElectronicLength <- nrow(materialElement_powerElectronic)

materialElement_permanentMagnet <- CompositionpermanentMagnet %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_permanentMagnetLength <- nrow(materialElement_permanentMagnet)

materialElement_engineCable <- CompositionengineCable %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_engineCableLength <- nrow(materialElement_engineCable)

materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnet <- CompositiongeneratorpermanentMagnet %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnetLength <- nrow(materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnet)

materialElement_generatorCable <- CompositiongeneratorCable %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_generatorCableLength <- nrow(materialElement_generatorCable)

ElementIndex <- 0

emptyData <- "N/A"

parameterCode <- c("e-p", "e-c", "e-m", "m-p", "m-c", "c-p")
parameterCodeIndex <- 5

parameter <- c("mass", "massFraction")
parameterIndex <- 1

unitOfMeasurementValue <- c("kg/unit", "g/unit")
unitOfMeasurementValueIndex <- 1

# Create a new workbook
wb1 <- createWorkbook()
wb2 <- createWorkbook()
```

# Run the loop

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

for (i in 1:6) {    # ProductKeyLevel1Length
  if(i == 1) {
    dataUse <- read_excel(filename35_input, sheet = "componentCarPetrol")
    component <- unique(dataUse$components)
    componentLength <- length(component)
    
    
    Materials <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialsICE")
    materialsLength <- length(Materials$materials) # will be different for different drivetrains
    
    tab_name <- "petrolCar_1990_2050"
  }
  else if (i == 2) {
    dataUse <- read_excel(filename35_input, sheet = "componentCarDiesel")
    component <- unique(dataUse$components)
    componentLength <- length(component)
    
    Materials <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialsICE")
    materialsLength <- length(Materials$materials) # will be different for different drivetrains
    
    tab_name <- "dieselCar_1990_2050"
  }
  else if (i == 3) {
    dataUse <- read_excel(filename35_input, sheet = "componentCarBEV")
    component <- unique(dataUse$components)
    componentLength <- length(component)
    
    Materials <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialsBEV")
    materialsLength <- length(Materials$materials) # will be different for different drivetrains
    
    tab_name <- "BEVCar_2000_2050"
  }
  else if (i == 4) {
    dataUse <- read_excel(filename35_input, sheet = "componentCarHEV")
    component <- unique(dataUse$components)
    componentLength <- length(component)
    
    Materials <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialsHEV")
    materialsLength <- length(Materials$materials) # will be different for different drivetrains
    
    tab_name <- "HEVCar_2000_2050"
  }
  else if (i == 5) {
    dataUse <- read_excel(filename35_input, sheet = "componentCarPHEV")
    component <- unique(dataUse$components)
    componentLength <- length(component)
    
    Materials <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialsPHEV")
    materialsLength <- length(Materials$materials) # will be different for different drivetrains
    
    tab_name <- "PHEVCar_2000_2050"
  }
  else if (i == 6) {
    dataUse <- read_excel(filename35_input, sheet = "componentCarOther")
    component <- unique(dataUse$components)
    componentLength <- length(component)
    
    Materials <- read_excel(filename32_input, sheet = "materialsOther")
    materialsLength <- length(Materials$materials) # will be different for different drivetrains
    
    tab_name <- "OtherCar_2000_2050"
  }
  
  addWorksheet(wb1, tab_name)
  addWorksheet(wb2, tab_name)
  
  startRow <- 1
  count <- 1
  
  for (j in 1:segmentsLength) {   # 
    if(i == 1 | i == 2) {
      startyear <- 1
    }
    else if(i == 3 | i == 4 | i == 5 | i == 6) {
      startyear <- 11 # BEV, HEV, PHEV, Other
    }
      for (k in startyear:yearLength) {
        
        # define component for l = 1 - elvBIW
        componentKeyLevel0Index <- 1
        componentKeyLevel1Index <- 1

      for (l in 1:(componentLength + 2)) {
        
        if (l <= componentLength) {
          
          dataAddYear <- dataUse %>% filter(segment == segments[j] & year == productionYear[k]  & components == component[l])
        
          # define materials for m = 1 - Al5xxx
          materialKeyLevel0Index <- 2
          materialKeyLevel1Index <- 2
          materialKeyLevel2Index <- 8
          materialKeyLevel3Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel4Index <- 0
        }
        else if(l == componentLength + 1) {
           
          dataAddYear <- dataUse %>% filter(segment == segments[j] & year == productionYear[k]  & components == component[componentLength])
          
          parameterCodeIndex <- 6
          
          componentKeyLevel0Index <- 0
          componentKeyLevel1Index <- 0
        
          # define materials for product
          materialKeyLevel0Index <- 4
          materialKeyLevel1Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel2Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel3Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel4Index <- 0
         
        }
        else if(l == componentLength + 2) {
           
          dataAddYear <- dataUse %>% filter(segment == segments[j] & year == productionYear[k]  & components == component[componentLength])
          
          parameterCodeIndex <- 5
          
          componentKeyLevel0Index <- 6
          componentKeyLevel1Index <- 0
        
          # define materials for rest
          materialKeyLevel0Index <- 4
          materialKeyLevel1Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel2Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel3Index <- 0
          materialKeyLevel4Index <- 0
        }
        if (l <= componentLength) {
          
        for (m in 1:materialsLength) {
          
          if(m == 16 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 3 | productKeyLevel1Index == 6)) {
            next
          }
          else if(m == 17 | m == 18 | m == 19 | m== 20) {
            
            # power electronics
            materialKeyLevel0Index <- 3
            materialKeyLevel1Index <- 11
            materialKeyLevel2Index <- 0
            materialKeyLevel3Index <- 0
            materialKeyLevel4Index <- 0
            
            next
          }
          else if(dataAddYear[[as.character(Materials[m, 1])]] != 0) {   # && !any(m %in% specific_values)
            
            if(m == 1) {
              elements <- materialElement_Al_5xxx$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_Al_5xxxLength
            }
            else if(m == 2) {
              elements <- materialElement_Al_6xxx$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_Al_6xxxLength
            }
            else if(m == 3) {
              elements <- materialElement_Al_7xxx$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_Al_7xxxLength
            }
            else if(m == 4) {
              elements <- materialElement_AlSiCu$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_AlSiCuLength
            }
            else if(m == 5) {
              elements <- materialElement_AlSiMg$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_AlSiMgLength
            }
              else if(m == 6 | m == 11 | m == 13) {          # stainless steel is closed to mild steel, same for alloy steel
              elements <- materialElement_mildSteel$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_mildSteelLength
            }
            else if(m == 7) {
              elements <- materialElement_HSS$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_HSSLength
            }
            else if(m == 8 | m == 12) {          # AHSS_DualPhase is close to AHSS
              elements <- materialElement_AHSS$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_AHSSLength
            }
            else if(m == 9) {
              elements <- materialElement_UHSS$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_UHSSLength
            }
            else if(m == 10 | m == 14) {
              elements <- materialElement_castIron$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_castIronLength
            }
            else if(m == 15) {
              elements <- materialElement_magnesium$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_magnesiumLength
            }
            else if(m == 16 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 1 | productKeyLevel1Index == 2 | productKeyLevel1Index == 4 | productKeyLevel1Index == 5 )) {
              elements <- materialElement_catalyst     # $Element not required
              elementLength <- materialElement_catalystLength
            }
            else if(m == 21) {
              elements <- materialElement_powerElectronic$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_powerElectronicLength
            }
            else if(m == 22) {
              elements <- materialElement_actuator$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_actuatorLength
            }
            else if(m == 23) {
              elements <- materialElement_controller$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_controllerLength
            }
            else if(m == 24) {
              elements <- materialElement_light$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_lightLength
            }
            else if(m == 25) {
              elements <- materialElement_cableLike$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_cableLikeLength
            }
            else if(m == 26 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 3 | productKeyLevel1Index == 4 | productKeyLevel1Index == 5 | productKeyLevel1Index == 6)) {
              elements <- materialElement_engineCable$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_engineCableLength
            }
            else if(m == 27 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 3 | productKeyLevel1Index == 4 | productKeyLevel1Index == 5 | productKeyLevel1Index == 6)) {
              elements <- materialElement_permanentMagnet$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_permanentMagnetLength
            }
            else if(m == 28 & productKeyLevel1Index == 3) {
              elements <- emptyData
              elementLength <- 0
            }
            else if(m == 28 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 4 | productKeyLevel1Index == 5)) {
              elements <- materialElement_generatorCable$Element
              elementLength <- materialElement_generatorCableLength
            }
            else if(m == 29 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 4 | productKeyLevel1Index == 5)) {
              elements <- materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnet$Element 
              elementLength <- materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnetLength
            }
            else if(m == 30 & (productKeyLevel1Index == 4 | productKeyLevel1Index == 5)) {
              elements <- emptyData
              elementLength <- 0
            }
            
            for (n in 0:elementLength) {
              if(n == 0) {
                parameterCodeIndex <- 5
              }
              else {
                parameterCodeIndex <- 3
              }
              
              data01 <- count      #dataEntryID
              data_short00 <- data01
  
              data02 <- "ELV"  #relatedFutuRaM-WS
              data03 <- "use"  #use/EoL
              data04 <- emptyValue    #uinqueStockOrFlowName
              data05 <- 0    #LoWchapter
              data06 <- emptyValue   #LoWsubChapter
              data07 <- emptyValue   #LoWkey
              data08 <- emptyValue   #ISRI
              data09 <- emptyValue   #HS
              data10 <- emptyValue   #collectionCategory
  
              if (productionYear[k] < predictionYear) {
                data_short01 <- "OBS"
              }
              else {
                data_short01 <- "BAU/REC/CIR"
              }
  
              #data11 <- NA  #productID
              data11 <- productID
  
              #data12 <- "elvUnknown"   #productKeyLevel1
              data12 <- productKeyLevel1[productKeyLevel1Index]
  
              #data13 <- "V01000000"    #productKeyLevel2
```
